recommendation: All three are useful provisional neutral/look source candidates for Mac review intake at the proposed sizes, with neutral still fallbacks. No distracting defect requiring new generation is established by this bounded review.

reviewed: Six retained registered source/output frame identities
Three APNGs rendered at proposed fractional CSS/world canvas sizes
Eighteen timestamped normal-speed browser screenshots covering neutral/look/return
notPerformed: Full Zod/Sharp decoder intake or canonical receipt creation
Continuous video perception or owner art approval
scope.newDrawingAccounting: This packet contains six producer-generated source drawings from one reported native call. This independent review created zero drawings and zero production clips.

criteria.principle: Distinct natural poses may redraw body and plumage. Pixel hashes enforce provenance; body-byte differences alone neither fail visual animation quality nor prove good movement.
mainGates: Readable species/individual appearance and coherent plumage/proportions
No gross body jump, distracting color/shape flash or obvious foot slide at normal size
Honest two-pose timing and fallback interpretation
criteria.hardCutInterpretation: These are two real pose drawings toggled for a brief upward glance, not a smooth intermediate-frame head turn, a blink, locomotion or interaction.

lesser_goldfinch.recommendation: Provisional neutral/look intake; neutral still is a valid fallback.
lesser_goldfinch.identity: At~36 world-pixel neutral width, the yellow underside, dark cap, olive/green back and contrasting wing patch remain readable as the intended small goldfinch source identity. Fine eye/toe detail naturally collapses at this size.
lesser_goldfinch.lookChange: Brief upward bill/head angle and a slightly more upright profile are visible. It reads as a tiny alert glance rather than an unrelated bird.
lesser_goldfinch.flickerContact: Small yellow/wing/toe redraw changes are visible in side-by-side inspection, but no conspicuous identity flash or rigid foot jump appears in the sampled world-size loop. Feet are too small for detailed anatomical contact approval.
lesser_goldfinch.limit: Owner should judge tiny foot/head legibility on actual yard backgrounds; source-scale toe texture is not a normal-size quality gate.

northern_mockingbird.recommendation: Provisional neutral/look intake, with still fallback if owner dislikes the crisp pose cut.
northern_mockingbird.identity: A pale gray/taupe, long-tailed, slim-billed and long-legged bird with clear white wing markings remains readable as the intended mockingbird. No conspicuous extra limb or collapsed body shape is visible.
northern_mockingbird.lookChange: Head/bill lift is clear at~80 world-pixel neutral width; body becomes slightly more upright while feet remain visually near the same place.
northern_mockingbird.flickerContact: Bold white wingbars, a warm plumage cast and minor wing/tail texture redraw are visible. They do not create a conspicuous whole-body flash in the inspected normal-size samples. The transition is visibly a crisp pose switch rather than smooth neck motion.
northern_mockingbird.limit: White wing markings are stylized/bold; final morphology/style approval remains with owner, not inferred from file verification.

california_scrub_jay.recommendation: Provisional neutral/look intake; retain neutral still as a practical non-loop fallback.
california_scrub_jay.identity: Crestless blue head/wings/tail, pale underside, eyebrow and brown-gray back remain clear. The strong blue throat/neck outline is a stylistic issue to retain for owner review, not an automatic rejection at intended size.
california_scrub_jay.lookChange: Upward head/bill posture is distinct at~98 world-pixel neutral width. Raised pose narrows total bill-to-tail image width and increases height; the same export scale/density is retained, so width change alone is not proof of a zoom.
california_scrub_jay.flickerContact: Some blue-wing/neck feather and torso contour change is visible between drawings. At the proposed world size it remains the same bird without a gross size jump or obvious foot slide in sampled playback. This is the most noticeable body/posture switch of the three, so still fallback should remain easy to select.
california_scrub_jay.limit: Detailed neckline/feather fidelity and owner tolerance for the200ms crisp look remain unapproved; no continuous animation-fluidity claim.

relativeScale.interpretation: Small goldfinch, medium mockingbird and larger scrub-jay ordering is visually sensible within this packet. The dimensions are proposed presentation sizes based on neutral bounding-box width, not independently calibrated anatomical bill-to-tail lengths.
relativeScale.browserFractionalLayout: Chromium at DPR1 resolves declared CSS widths to layout-grid precision; actual captured element sizes are recorded. Fractional display scaling and target-device rasterization remain separate from anatomical motion.

footAndContactEvidence.interpretation: Coarse alpha128 masks in presumed foot regions show world-centroid differences~0.708/~0.231/~0.135 and no temporal lowest-boundary change. These statistics support visual stance stability, but are not tracked anatomical toe correspondences or physical-support approval.
footAndContactEvidence.commonContactPixels: All producer-declared common contact pixels remain alpha-positive in both poses; this is a technical registration property, not certified toe-center/ground contact.
footAndContactEvidence.normalSizeVisualResult: No obvious foot translation, vertical hop or detached leg is visible in the inspected normal-size samples.

provenanceLimits.verified: Original file hash matches the intake record; six source IDs recompute from decoded registered RGBA; source/output PNG hashes match; every output exactly reproduces uniform whole-canvas nearest export; atlas hashes match manifests; APNG decoded frames exactly match neutral/look/neutral.
provenanceLimits.notClaimed: Full independent inverse reconstruction of principal-component atlas ownership, current global-bank registration, canonical server decoder receipt or remote/Git publication state.
provenanceLimits.bodyPixelChanges: Retained as redraw evidence and visible-flicker context, never used as a universal admission failure.

timing.lookEndpointStyle: One sudden pose switch upward and one sudden return. That can serve as a brief discrete alert look; it is not represented as smooth multi-frame motion.
timing.endpointIdentity: Exact neutral endpoints prevent a boundary mismatch, but endpoint equality alone does not establish perceptual quality.

normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.method: page.set_content of exact retained self-containedHTML, normal APNG speed, unique Blob URL per restart
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.methodLimit: Normal-speed APNGs ran in Chromium; samples were awaited on wall time, not manually advanced. Captured still states were inspected chronologically. Screenshot spans and load/compositor clocks limit precise boundary timing; this is not a human continuously watching the full loop or real Mac yard playback.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.evidenceRetention: Contact-sheet PNGs are embedded in this review JSON so no separate source/packet files were written.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.noFileNavigationAttempted: Used supported page.set_content of the existing self-contained HTML; no network/proxy/policy changes.

admissionAndBehaviorLimits.intakeRecommendation: Try the existing Mac review path with either the two-pose idle/look atlas or the supplied neutral static fallback.
admissionAndBehaviorLimits.approvalAndActivation: Retain unreviewed/activation-none semantics until the actual canonical path and owner provide their separate approvals.
admissionAndBehaviorLimits.behaviorInterpretation: Neutral/look source coverage is partial species coverage. Hops/runs, seed/berry/cache interactions, drinking, preening, flight/rest and their runtime bindings are not established by these canons.

nextStep: Parent coordinates canonical source registration/storage and Mac provisional review intake; owner may choose neutral stills if the brief hard-cut looks distract in the actual yard. No mandatory new-art reroll is justified solely by the redraw hashes or this bounded review.
